item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 26/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a fresh to strong northeast monsoon, it will be windy, fine and dry with cool mornings over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. With the monsoon moderating midweek this week, temperatures over the coast of Guangdong will rise slightly. The weather will be mainly fine over the region in the following few days. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 26/02 (Sunday)
Wind: Northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly fine and dry. Rather cool with cloudy periods in the morning.
Temp range: 14 - 20 C
R.H. range: 45 - 70 per Cent
PSR: Low
